verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office and compliance platform, so letting an agent track renewals and deadlines through an API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows a human-facing compliance dashboard that displays upcoming state deadlines, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for API access. No API is documented, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, so there is no evidence an agent could monitor deadlines or act on them programmatically.
